python3 -c '
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img33 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0033.png"))

# Lamp base in obs 33:
# Dark circular base on the ground
# Base color is dark grey/blue: ~ (70-90, 80-100, 100-120)
mask_lamp = (img33[:,:,0] > 50) & (img33[:,:,0] < 120) & (img33[:,:,1] > 60) & (img33[:,:,1] < 120) & (img33[:,:,2] > 80) & (img33[:,:,2] < 140) & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 400)
coords_lamp = np.argwhere(mask_lamp)
if len(coords_lamp) > 0:
    print("Lamp base y:", coords_lamp[:,0].min(), coords_lamp[:,0].max(), "x:", coords_lamp[:,1].min(), coords_lamp[:,1].max())

# Cabinet corners in obs 33:
# Front-left, front-right, back-left, back-right
# Let us inspect the cabinet mask
mask_cab = (img33[:,:,0] > 180) & (img33[:,:,1] > 160) & (img33[:,:,2] > 120) & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 280) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 300)
coords_cab = np.argwhere(mask_cab)
if len(coords_cab) > 0:
    print("Cabinet y:", coords_cab[:,0].min(), coords_cab[:,0].max(), "x:", coords_cab[:,1].min(), coords_cab[:,1].max())
'
